reviews.comment: She is super energetic and funny, every single class, despite only reading off slides. She gives two possible test questions after every class, so I would recommend going. Material isn't hard! Memorizing her slides the day before got me a high B on every test. There aren't many assignments, so make sure you do well on those, but also not hard at al

Dr. Fik is the absolute sweetest person ever! She is passionate about the material and teaches it well, lectures were very interactive. She also cares about her students beyond the classroom and had a little celebration for the seniors graduating this semester! I really enjoyed this class and learned a lot!

She is understanding and wants to see you succeed. She is a tough grader when it comes to writing assignments, but there are only 3 or 4 of them. She does a good job giving you the information needed and you do not have to do any extra reading outside of class.

Professor Winata is the best prof you will ever have! She is very caring and accessible out of class. If you show genuine interest in the material, she will help you in the best way possible. The exams are fairly easy. Just know every little detail from the slides and do the knowledge checking questions (she gives these at the end of each class).

Very straightforward, organized and easy class. She is kind and gives enthusiastic, interesting lectures. The only work is 3 Perusall discussions, 3 writing assignments(a few paragraphs each) 3 exams and extra credit near the end. NO final/comprehensive exam. At the end of each lecture she shows questions that will be on the next exam, so show up!

She basically gives away free marks at times. You have writing assignments and Perusall which are very easy to get 90+. Gives away free 100 points for course reflection and some extra credit for GIS Day. Her exams can be a little challenging, but doable. Attendance not mandatory but gives away exam-like questions at end of class so I suggest going.

Great prof. Only 10 total assignments. 3 exams, 3 writing assignments, 3 discussion, 1 course reflection(completion grade really). Exams aren't bad. Definitely go over the information on the slides a couple of times. The writing and discussion assignments are pretty easy and there is no reason to get below a 90 on any of them.
The best prof I've ever had. Super sweet and understanding. Should be an almost guaranteed a if you just go to class and listen. Her lectures are super understandable and tests aren't very difficult.

The G.O.A.T. She has a very uplifting personality. In a lecture hall of over 100 students, she still puts on a smile when no one answers. She's awesome. Make sure to actually pay attention and study. It's VERY test heavy.

She was the best professor. She does not like failing student which requires you as a student to do your work. If you do your work and study you will succeed in this class. For exams we had an options for cheat sheets which is not likely to happen after this semester. Overall she is a great professor.

She is kind and understanding, especially to those who come to class. Her tests are relatively easy, and wouldn't have been anything to worry about without the cheat sheet (which she is removing). All you have to do is learn the material, go to lecture, and you're good for at least an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very easy class as long as you show up for lecture quizzes and do your homework every week. On tests you can have a cheat sheet where you can just put information from the quizzes and slides and ace the class.

I'm not usually the one to gripe about this... but she was overly enthusiastic. I love a happy and outgoing professor, but she is somewhat over the top. Her exams are open note, and everything she talks about in lecture comes straight from the slides. She never expanded beyond the information given. Print out all the slide info and u can make an A

Loved this professor! It was an interesting course. However, it was a bit repetitive at times! A super easy A+!! All exam questions come from daily checks, lecture questions, and module quizzes. you are also allowed a white page filled with notes/info for all exams ("cheat sheet"). One project & 3 writing assignments!  all grading is very light!

I absolutely loved Prof Fik! She truly has such a passion for human geography and made it very interesting. There are 3 exams with a project, but all are easy if you study. She does assign work frequently, but also gives out lots of extra credit. Would 100% take her again - this class is an easy A+ if you turn in your work. PLEASE TAKE HER CLASS!!!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
